reason: The FHIR side carries the BCP 47 tag pt-BR and openEHR binds language to its own ISO_639-1 code set, which holds alpha-2 codes only, so the region subtag is dropped and the openEHR side records pt. The narrowing is not reversible: converting the openEHR side back gives Attachment.language pt, not pt-BR. The dv-encapsulated.language row declares the drop.
